meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能检查 opencode 这个编程助手本身是否正常:可以验证命令行、网络服务、插件事件和终端界面,也能在数据库中按 id、标题或消息内容查找历史会话。自带多个测试脚本,每个都带自检功能。
howto.when: 当你要求检查或调试 opencode 本身,如说“opencode qa”“test opencode”等,或想按 id/标题/消息查找会话时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一遍 opencode 的自检测试脚本,确认环境正常。
say.note: 会依次执行各脚本的 --self-test 并回报结果。

say.text: 验证 opencode 的插件事件流,看看 hook 是否触发。
say.note: 会启动隔离服务并监听 /event 流。

say.text: 按标题查一下最近包含“授权重构”的会话。
say.note: 会用只读方式查 SQLite 数据库。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude QA opencode itself: verify the CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events and TUI, or inspect sessions in the SQLite DB by id/title/message text. It ships helper scripts, each with a --self-test.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to QA/smoke-test/verify/debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or find sessions in its DB by id/title/text (e.g. "opencode qa", "test opencode").

say_en.text: Run the opencode self-tests and confirm the environment is healthy.
say_en.note: Executes each script's --self-test and reports results.

say_en.text: Verify opencode's plugin event stream to see if a hook fired.
say_en.note: Starts an isolated server and listens to /event.

say_en.text: Find sessions whose title contains "auth refactor".
say_en.note: Reads the SQLite DB in read-only mode.
